description: This file defines a utility function `determineEndpointType` that determines the appropriate API endpoint type based on a selected model identifier and a list of model information objects. It imports necessary types and functions from other modules and exports the main function used for endpoint type selection.

methods.name: determineEndpointType
methods.description: Determines the appropriate endpoint type based on the selected model and model information array. It looks up the model info matching the selected model and returns the endpoint type accordingly, defaulting to 'CHAT' if no matching info is found.
